rounds: Paying in cash is a basic freedom, and nobody should ask what it's for.
If a friend paid me back with a thick pile of €50 notes, I'd ask where it came from.
Crime series on Netflix make money laundering look far too cool.
I'd give my bank more of my personal data if it helped stop fraud.
Very rich people should have to explain where their money came from.
Whistleblowers should get a share of the fines they help to collect.
A fine, however big, teaches a big bank nothing.
Banks are far too nosy about where their customers' money comes from.
